note: This file contains only data definitions (lists and dicts of compiler flags). There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is a configuration source consumed by generate_copts.py, configure_copts.bzl, and AbseilConfigureCopts.cmake.
summary: Abseil compiler options configuration — defines platform-specific warning flags, defines, and link options for GCC, LLVM/Clang, Clang-CL, and MSVC compilers, plus hardware AES flags for ARM64, ARM32, and x64.

variables.MSVC_BIG_WARNING_FLAGS: List of MSVC warning level flags (e.g. /W3)
variables.LLVM_BIG_WARNING_FLAGS: List of Clang/LLVM warning enable flags (e.g. -Wall, -Wextra, -Weverything)
variables.LLVM_DISABLE_WARNINGS_FLAGS: List of Clang/LLVM warning disable flags for Abseil code
variables.LLVM_TEST_DISABLE_WARNINGS_FLAGS: Additional warning disable flags for test code under Clang/LLVM
variables.MSVC_DEFINES: List of MSVC preprocessor defines (e.g. NOMINMAX, WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
variables.COPT_VARS: Dict mapping variable names (e.g. ABSL_GCC_FLAGS, ABSL_LLVM_FLAGS, ABSL_MSVC_FLAGS) to lists of compiler/linker flags per platform

use_cases: Reference ABSL_GCC_FLAGS for GCC compiler warning configuration
Reference ABSL_LLVM_FLAGS for Clang/LLVM compiler warning configuration
Reference ABSL_MSVC_FLAGS for MSVC compiler warning and define configuration
Reference ABSL_RANDOM_HWAES_*_FLAGS for hardware AES instruction flags per architecture
Modify flag lists then run generate_copts.py to regenerate build system copts
